articles.summary: Annual Awards Program Recognizes Breakthrough Innovation in Automotive Transportation Technologies Around the Globe indie Semiconductor (Nasdaq: INDI), an automotive solutions innovator, today announced it has been awarded “In-Cabin Solution of the Year” by AutoTech Breakthrough, a leading market intelligence organization that recognizes the top companies, technologies and products in the global automotive and transportation markets. indie's Combined SoC and Perception Software for Advanced DMS/OMS Awarded In-Cabin Solution of the Year indie’s combined driver and occupant monitoring system (DMS/OMS) in-cabin platform is a pre-integrated pairing of the company’s next-generation Edge AI SoC, iND881 , with its emotion3D in-cabin perception stack. The platform can be deployed as a fully pre-integrated hardware–software package with the iND881, or used independently as a standalone perception software offering, providing greater flexibility to meet customer architectural
articles.title: indie's Combined SoC and Perception Software for Advanced DMS/OMS Awarded In-Cabin Solution of the Year

articles.summary: indie Semiconductor, Inc. (Nasdaq: INDI), an automotive solutions innovator, plans to conduct a conference call with analysts to discuss its third quarter 2026 results and business outlook on November 5, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time. After the close of the market on November 5 and prior to the conference call, indie Semiconductor, Inc. (“indie”) will issue a copy of the earnings press release via Business Wire. The press release may also be viewed on indie’s website at https://investors.indie.inc/news . To listen to the conference call via the Internet, please go to the Financials tab on the Investors page of indie’s website. To listen to the conference call via telephone, please call (877) 451-6152 (domestic) or (201) 389-0879 (international). A replay of the conference call will be available beginning at 9:00 p.m. Eastern time on November 5, 2026, until 11:59 p.m. Eastern time on November 19, 2026, under the Financials tab on the Investors page of indie’s website, or by calling
articles.title: indie Sets Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
